canonical_title: Failures outside the regions of tolerable handling

versions.title_at_revision: Failures outside the regions of tolerable handling
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle is capable of returning to the ROSH and ROTH after encountering any failure outside of the ROTH but within the RORH. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct FMECA to assess the air vehicle flying qualities after encountering any failure outside of the ROTH but within the RORH. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess that air vehicle can be flown to particular flight conditions outside of the ROTH and return to the ROSH or ROTH under the failure conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess that air vehicle can be flown to selected flight conditions outside of the ROTH and return to the ROSH or ROTH under the failure conditions.
